seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: Extend the sphere, and you take in a greater variety of parties and interests
seeds.external_lens_identity: Cross-cutting cleavages theory (Georg Simmel; Robert Goodin's 1975 synthesis)
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 这里的机制不只是“大国人更多”，而是把宗教、财产、行业、债务等分歧做成交叉裂缝，降低单一多数阵营稳定结块的概率。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，这句从地理扩张口号变成了结构性解释：联邦的安全性来自裂缝彼此交叉，而不只是来自规模本身。
source_leads: Robert E. Goodin, 'Cross-Cutting Cleavages and Social Conflict,' British Journal of Political Science 5(4), 1975. https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/british-journal-of-political-science/article/abs/crosscutting-cleavages-and-socialconf
Georg Simmel, Conflict and the Web of Group-Affiliations, 1955. Referenced in Goodin 1975.

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: the most numerous party, or, in other words, the most powerful faction must be expected to prevail
seeds.external_lens_identity: Public choice and rent-seeking (James Buchanan & Gordon Tullock; Anne Krueger)
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 麦迪逊这里写的不是抽象“偏私”，而是可预测的分配性寻租：立法者同时是利益相关方时，债务、关税、税负会变成制度化的转移争夺。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，债权人与债务人、制造业与土地利益的段落，不再只是道德警告，而像是在描述立法场域为何天然会滑向寻租竞争。
source_leads: James M. Buchanan and Gordon Tullock, The Calculus of Consent, 1962. https://oll.libertyfund.org/titles/buchanan-the-calculus-of-consent-logical-foundations-of-constitutional-democracy
David R. Henderson, 'Rent Seeking,' Econlib encyclopedia entry, with leads to Tullock 1967 and Krueger 1974. https://www.econlib.org/library/Enc/RentSeeking.html?to_print=true

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: refine and enlarge the public views, by passing them through the medium of a chosen body of citizens
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 代表制在这里可用“筛选机制”来读：它不只是替人民发声，而是在更大候选池中提高挑出高能力、低地方偏狭代理人的概率。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，这段不只是对代表的德性期待，而是在提出一个选择模型：扩大选民与候选池，能改变当选者类型。
source_leads: Ernesto Dal Bo and Frederico Finan, 'Progress and Perspectives in the Study of Political Selection,' NBER Working Paper 24783, 2018. https://www.nber.org/papers/w24783
Andrew Beath, Fotini Christia, Georgy Egorov, Ruben Enikolopov, 'Electoral Rules and Political Selection,' Review of Economic Studies 83(3), 2016; NBER version: https://www.nber.org/papers/w20082

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: communication is always checked by distrust in proportion to the number whose concurrence is necessary
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 这句给出的其实是协调成本机制：多数人即便共享压迫动机，也未必能形成共同知识与可靠协同；人数越大，串联越脆弱。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，联邦并非只靠“意见更多”来抑制多数暴政，而是靠让潜在压迫联盟更难互认、互信、同步行动。
source_leads: Mancur Olson, The Logic of Collective Action, 1965; overview: https://www.econlib.org/library/enc/bios/olson.html

Michael Chwe, Rational Ritual: Culture, Coordination, and Common Knowledge, 2001; cited in Mai Hassan, 'Coordinated Dis-Coordination,' American Political Science Review 118(1), 2024. https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/american-pical-sc
